capabilities: Organize new attachments automatically into templated folders and filenames as soon as they are linked
Adopt unmanaged attachments in a note, the whole vault, or a folder and move them into place
Reapply rules to managed attachments with a previewed diff, idempotently
Move attachments when their note is renamed, updating every link in notes and canvases
Scan folders for attachments with no links and manage folder exclusions
extras: Not yet in the official Obsidian Community Plugins directory, so it must be installed through BRAT.
intentEvidence: Every attachment-management plugin for Obsidian promises the same thing
motivation: The author built it to fix three edge cases in existing attachment plugins: missed bulk imports, compounding filename templates, and moves that leave other references broken.
problem: Existing attachment plugins miss bulk-imported attachments, corrupt filenames when rules are reapplied, and only rewrite links in the note that triggered a move.
summary: Attachment organizer that moves linked files into templated folders and filenames, handling bulk imports, idempotent renames, and vault-wide link updates.
